style: TH453 Kilauan anamorfik (Thumbnail Style Library) — sama seperti video pertama siri KEBAIKAN KECIL
prompt:
Create ONE scroll-stopping vertical video cover (thumbnail), 9:16 portrait, for a short Malay video in the series "Kebaikan Kecil": on a rainy night a young person shares his umbrella with an old man.

VISUAL STYLE (same as the first video of this series): dark night city, deep black and charcoal tones, one electric-blue horizontal anamorphic light streak across the middle of the frame, soft cinematic glow, heavy diagonal rain streaks catching the light, wet ground with mirror reflections. Fill the whole canvas edge to edge, no letterbox bars, no borders, no empty padding.

The attached image is ONLY a character reference: keep the same minimal stickman style (a glowing white stickman for the young person, a light grey hunched stickman with a walking stick for the old man). Do NOT copy its camera angle or layout.

SCENE: low angle at ground level. The glowing white young stickman holds a dark umbrella tilted fully over the hunched old man; the young man's own shoulder is outside the umbrella and rain drops splash on him. Under the umbrella the old man is dry and protected. Their reflections shimmer in the puddles below. The two figures are large and centred in the lower half.

HEADLINE TEXT (the only text in the image, in Malay, written EXACTLY with this spelling, ultra-bold condensed sans-serif, huge, in the upper third, inside safe margins so nothing is cut off, with a heavy dark outline so it stays readable on a phone):
Line 1: DIA SANGGUP BASAH...  (white)
Line 2: UNTUK ORANG ASING  (electric blue glow, larger than line 1)

Each piece of text appears exactly once; never repeat or duplicate any word. Do NOT add any other text, labels, captions, logos, watermarks, borders or UI elements.
